description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing Kubernetes ReplicaSet resources, including CRUD operations, scaling, and applying configurations within the extensions/v1beta1 API group.

classes.name: replicaSets
classes.description: Implementation of the ReplicaSetInterface for managing ReplicaSet resources within a namespace.

methods.name: newReplicaSets
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new replicaSets client for a specific namespace.

methods.name: GetScale
methods.description: Retrieves the Scale subresource for a specified ReplicaSet.

methods.name: UpdateScale
methods.description: Updates the Scale subresource for a specified ReplicaSet.

methods.name: ApplyScale
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to the Scale subresource of a ReplicaSet.
